sources.title: Brief-supplied audience and core message
sources.notes: The brief is authoritative for user-supplied requirements and asset links, not for independent audience evidence.

findings.observation: The Mixed Bag page describes a range of single-estate coffees from light to dark: Seethargundu light, Thogarihunkal medium, Attikan medium-dark and Vienna dark. It is sold as a pack of 5 or 10.
findings.interpretation: The Mixed Bag is a variety product, so the film can show a range of roast levels without inventing a new assortment.
findings.proposed_action: Use the Mixed Bag as the hero and show four packs: Mixed Bag, Seethargundu light, Attikan medium-dark and Vienna dark. Say only 'light to dark'.

findings.observation: The brewing instructions say to tear the outer sachet, tear the filter top, anchor the filter over a 180-200 ml cup, pour hot water, wait 20 seconds, repeat 2-3 times, then steep for 2 minutes.
findings.interpretation: The real action is a multi-step brew with a steep that cannot fit in 20 seconds at real speed. A truthful demo needs time compression and a visible disclosure.
findings.proposed_action: Show tear, anchor and pour, then compress the repeated pours and steep with a time-lapse cue and the caption 'Brew sequence compressed'.

findings.observation: The Easy Pour FAQ says it is not powdered instant coffee or a premix, but is as quick and hassle-free to brew.
findings.interpretation: Calling it instant coffee would be a category error. The ad should contrast specialty coffee with the convenience, not the product.
findings.proposed_action: Use 'specialty coffee' and 'no equipment', never 'instant coffee'.
findings.evidence_locator: FAQ: Is this the same as instant coffee?

findings.observation: The Mixed Bag page lists pack of 5 at Rs 300 and pack of 10 at Rs 500. The brief does not approve a price or hero pack size.
findings.interpretation: Price and pack size are observed commercial values. They cannot enter the ready cut without brand approval.
findings.proposed_action: Keep price out of the ready cut and hold the hero pack size for brand confirmation.

findings.observation: The storefront exposes the Blue Tokai logo and product images on its CDN, but the brief supplies links only and no advertising licence or brand kit.
findings.interpretation: The images are technically usable references, not cleared paid-media assets. Pack labels are exact commercial elements.
findings.proposed_action: Use the observed URLs as the asset source of record, request written advertising approval, and hold the pack and logo until cleared.

findings.observation: Google recommends 1920x1080 horizontal and 1080x1920 vertical video, and publishes placement-specific safe-zone templates.
findings.interpretation: 16:9 is a valid YouTube master. Exact safe insets must be checked against the chosen placement rather than assumed universal.
findings.proposed_action: Plan a 1920x1080 master with conservative insets and a placement preview before paid media.
findings.evidence_locator: Video ad specs table and safe-zone templates

findings.observation: Google's ABCD guidance asks for early attention, early and repeated branding, focused connection and a clear direction or CTA.
findings.interpretation: A 20-second ad can use a 3-second hook, a 7-second demo, a 5-second range proof and a 5-second close.
findings.proposed_action: Put the pack and brand in the hook, keep the demo single-minded, and land the CTA on the end card.

findings.observation: The brand's brew instructions include a 2-minute steep after pouring. A 20-second film cannot show that at real speed.
findings.interpretation: Time compression is a production treatment, not a product claim. It needs an on-screen disclosure so the demo remains honest.
findings.proposed_action: Use a time-lapse transition and a small 'Brew sequence compressed' disclaimer in the payoff shot.

findings.observation: The brief defines the viewer as busy Indian professionals who already buy cafe or instant coffee and want specialty coffee without equipment.
findings.interpretation: The viewer needs the benefit demonstrated, not a origin lecture. The hook should name the category and show the pack immediately.
findings.proposed_action: Open on 'Specialty coffee' with the pack; use the demo as proof.
findings.evidence_locator: Brief target audience and core message

findings.observation: No finished voice-over, music bed or demonstration footage was supplied.
findings.interpretation: The demo and audio are production requirements with rights and consent gates, not assets already available.
findings.proposed_action: Record the demo, voice and music in Level 2; hold the performer and licence approvals.

findings.observation: The brief names the Mixed Bag, Vienna and Attikan Estate packs and supplies the logo and product-image links. Seethargundu is added from the Mixed Bag page to provide the light endpoint.
findings.interpretation: The exact product set is fixed by the brief, while the creative use of each pack still needs a composition decision.
findings.proposed_action: Use Mixed Bag as hero, Seethargundu, Attikan and Vienna as range support, and keep each label unobstructed.

findings.observation: The brand describes Easy Pour as specialty coffee brewed with hot water in a 180-200 ml cup, with no equipment.
findings.interpretation: The core message is supported by the brand's own instructions, but it is still brand-authored rather than independent product testing.
findings.proposed_action: Use 'no equipment' and 'just a mug and hot water' as brand-supported wording, not a superiority claim.

synthesis: The product and its core benefit are supported by Blue Tokai's own product and brewing pages: a single-serve sachet with a built-in paper filter, brewed over a 180-200 ml cup with hot water, and a Mixed Bag spanning light to dark roasts. The honest creative route is a visible demo, not an instant-coffee comparison. Price, pack sizes and public product images are observed commercial material and remain rights or approval holds. A real brew includes repeated pours and a two-minute steep, so the film must disclose time compression rather than imply real-time brewing. The range shot needs a real light endpoint, so Seethargundu is added to the supplied Vienna and Attikan packs.
